reviewedDimensions: Read the actual four-serving method for each of the 90 sides, including ingredient forms and full cooking/dressing sequence.
Compared gluten-free/dairy-free forms at 1, 4 and 12 servings; evaluated long grain cooking windows, water starting quantities, cooling and hot holding.
Inspected regional spice/seed/herb/paste forms and measured sauce inputs; reviewed real Japanese, Persian, Italian and long-grain side meal outputs.

changes.finding: Whole sorghum was assigned 40 minutes to become tender.
changes.result: 50–60-minute producer window, 65-minute grain step and 70-minute side budget; scaled generous boiling water and topping-up instruction.

changes.finding: Freekeh and farro product forms were unspecified while the plan assumed short cooking.
changes.result: Cracked freekeh and pearled farro named explicitly; longer whole-grain packet methods are not interchangeable. Separate quinoa and brown-rice substitute windows.

changes.finding: Dairy-free polenta, millet, oats/rice flakes and risotto gave no measurable starting liquid; risotto could dry out while awaiting its pea finish.
changes.result: Scaled water starting quantities with packet/texture overrides; risotto reserves hot water for finishing. Dairy polenta already scaled its 1000 ml suggestion; it was not a pre-existing scaling defect.

changes.finding: Most cooked-grain sides lacked holding/cooling guidance.
changes.result: Prompt service or 60°C hot holding, cold garnishes chilled, shallow rapid cooling to refrigeration at 5°C, one reheating; thermometer equipment.

changes.finding: Garlic/ginger/onion powder retaining a fresh catalogue ID inherited mincing and 1–2-minute frying.
changes.result: Explicit powdered forms now bloom briefly as spices.

changes.finding: Powdered or flaked dried chilli inherited whole-chilli stem preparation; counted cloves and cinnamon quills missed whole-piece handling.
changes.result: Preparation follows actual supplied form; counted woody pieces removed; edible cardamom seeds ground rather than discarded.

changes.finding: Fallback water used the ingredient scaling ratio, leaving already-scaled 12-serving no-liquid sauce at 30 ml; delicate-only miso borrowed nonexistent warm sauce.
changes.result: Water scales from servings independently of input quantity basis, and delicate-only warm sauces establish an actual liquid base.

notChanged: All 90 side IDs, default food quantities, oil/acid amounts and dietary alternatives retained; cooking forms/timing/liquids were the clear issues, not arbitrary portion reductions.

Japanese medium yuzu kosho remained at the authored amount. S&B producer recipes include a tablespoon for a four-serving chicken sauce; the evidence did not establish a universal lower limit. Heat settings are intentionally different, and saltiness is product dependent.
Cassava restriction, two-stage tostones, sticky-rice soaking and miso-aubergine glaze staging were already corrected in the preceding audit and were rechecked, not claimed as new changes.
limits: Plausibility review and producer guidance, not kitchen tasting or a claim that every combination is a traditional dish.
No full 2,012,924-case rerun, build or deployment performed in this subtask.
Generated meal samples reflect concurrent root-owned meal-generator changes; owned-source hashes identify side/helper state.
